change_description: Keep the iteration-1 terminal 0.30 execution-price floor and add one high-price support-recovery path: when v8.1 emits NO_TRADE but the frozen guard row has an existing v6.7 guard-compatible action, recover that exact action only if its matched decision-time execution_price is at least 0.30. Do not change controller state, model scores, action identity, costs, lifecycle, or fixed 0.2 size.
expected_mechanism: Iteration 1 proved positive absolute edge but failed only the paired LCB. Recovering high-price v6.7 actions should increase market-level support and correlation with the baseline, reducing paired-difference variance, while the unchanged 0.30 floor continues to suppress cheap-contract tail exposure. This is a development hypothesis and never promotion evidence.
mechanistic_rationale: The first preregistered candidate passed the absolute, largest-winner-removal, temporal-half, support, and safety gates, but its paired 97.5% LCB remained -0.15145125 despite a +1.33240 point delta. That pattern indicates the remaining problem is paired-difference dispersion, not candidate absolute edge. A high-price-only recovery path reintroduces baseline correlation on a timestamp-safe, interpretable subset without weakening the existing price floor or running a threshold grid.
